title: Unequal-Mass 4-Corner Mixture (2% Rare Mode) (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `vector_unequal_mass` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Four corner Gaussians with highly skewed weights [55%, 30%, 13%, 2%]. Tests whether the trainer preserves both the exact share (min_mass_ratio >= 0.25, mass_tv <= 0.15) and local covariance of a rare 2% cluster.
failure_mode: Rare clusters receive sparse minibatch signal and get either absorbed into major modes, over-equalized (destroying mass_tv), or flattened into degenerate 1D lines.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `vector_unequal_mass` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
